exposure: Introduction of ST segment analysis (STAN) of the fetal electrocardiogram
cohort: The study included 1,132,022 singleton births with a gestational age of 36 weeks or beyond in Norway between 1985 and 2014.
finding: The introduction of STAN was not associated with changes in stillbirths, neonatal deaths, intrapartum cesarean sections, or instrumental vaginal deliveries, but was associated with a small increase in neonates with Apgar scores <7 at 5 minutes.
mod_finding: The introduction of STAN was not associated with changes in intrapartum cesarean sections or instrumental vaginal deliveries.
